in_marathi.name: Punya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Punya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'punya', meaning merit, virtue. In Hinduism, it is believed that good deeds accumulate 'punya' and contribute to one's spiritual growth and eventual liberation from the cycle of birth and death.

In Hinduism, it is believed that good deeds accumulate 'punya' and contribute to one's spiritual growth and eventual liberation from the cycle of birth and death.
